fee_notes: The Franchise Fee is currently $25,000, payable upon signing the Agreement. The franchisor may, in its sole discretion, reduce the Franchise Fee if: the franchisee or affiliates are an existing Motel 6 and/or Studio 6 franchisee in compliance with their Agreements; the franchisee is signing multiple Agreements at the same time; a reduction is appropriate due to market conditions or market penetration; or the franchisee qualifies for a LIGHT THE WAY incentive program. For a Dual Brand Operation, a separate Franchise Fee is required for the Motel and the Studio 6 Motel. Additional fixed pre-opening fees include: Application Fee ($5,000), Site Evaluation/PIP Fee ($1,950), Opening Package Fee ($4,750), and Opening Assistance Fee ($4,600). Variable pre-opening fees include: Initial General Manager Training for Additional Person ($750/attendee), Ancillary Trip Fee ($900), Inspection/Re-Inspection Fee ($3,000–$5,000), and Opening Extension Fee ($2,500–$5,000).
